def clean(df):
    df['Category'] = df['Category'].str.strip()
    df['Region'] = df['Region'].str.title()
    allowed_regions = ['North', 'South', 'East', 'West']
    df = df[df['Region'].isin(allowed_regions) & df['Region'].notna()]
    original_quantity = df['Quantity']
    df['Quantity'] = original_quantity.astype(int)
    df = df[(original_quantity == df['Quantity']) & (df['Quantity'] >= 1)]
    return df

def answer(df):
    return df.groupby('Region')['Quantity'].sum().to_dict()
